messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — we heard recurring asks about why we win/lose. Need clear owners and small deliverables so field stops repeating the same asks.

Sam (Product): Short recap: predictable latency tiers, a Week-0 checklist, SLO templates, and a simple hosted->dedicated migration matrix.

Ravi (Sales): Field color: 3 pilots stalled over price predictability and lack of private deployment checklist. We lost one mid-market deal yesterday for that reason.

Elena (CS): Wins: customers consistently praised our canary->auto-failover story. They want a one-page checklist they can share with procurement.

Nora (Docs): I can draft: (a) Week-0 smoke checks, (b) SLO 1-pager, (c) short migration matrix. ETA 4 business days for drafts.

Sam (Product): Prioritize SLO templates and the private checklist first. I'll rank impact/effort and add owners.

Ravi (Sales): Please include one-line rebuttals for common objections (cost, isolation, rollback).

Ava (CEO): Good. Sam & Nora: consolidate items into a single tracking doc and share link here when ready.

OpsBot: Created tickets #DOCS-211 (Week-0 checklist) assigned to docs-team, #FEAT-931 (per-tenant throttles exploration) assigned to eng-infra.

Elena (CS): I'll reach out to the lost prospects and offer a brief technical review/checklist to unblock re-engagement.

Sam (Product): Draft tracking doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/allhands/1821503210-actions — adding owners now.

Ava (CEO): Thanks all. We'll review progress in the ops sync in two weeks. If anyone adds items, ping me.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: review tracking doc in 10 business days.
